name: smwgraphics-super-mario-maker-super-mario-world-dry-bones
title: Super Mario Maker: Super Mario World - Dry Bones
description:
Dry Bones from Super Mario Maker (it's the same in SMM2). I'm quite surprised that nobody has ripped this before.

You must use it with a patch that edits its displacement (included). Also, I had to use a second tile for its head, because I didn't manage to use a single tile for its walking animation.

Please give credit, It was hard to find the correct values for the displacement. No custom palette required.
